svg.text: Autoregressive Generation + Token Sampling 🔁🎲
An LLM writes one token at a time. At each step it has a probability distribution over the whole vocabulary —
how you pick one token from it is the thing you actually control.
🔄 The loop (Step 3 is where this lesson zooms in)
1 · Input Tokens
= context window
2 · Compute Probs
over whole vocab
3 · Select Token
👈 focus
4 · Stop or
continue?
"continue" → append token → feed window back → repeat 🔁
🧠 Context window (prompt + hidden system/template tokens) = the model's ONLY input & memory, with a fixed max size.
🎲 Each step → a distribution over the whole vocab. ⚠️ Crucial: the model selects by probability, not correctness.
🎚️ Picking ONE token from the distribution — the heart of this merge
🎯 Greedy — always take the argmax (highest-prob token). Deterministic. ⚠️ But it sounds boring/boilerplate
("Sure, here's a…", "As a large language model…") and can fall into repetition loops (Xu et al., 2022).
🎰 Random sampling — spin a wheel weighted by the probabilities → diversity. ⚠️ Unfiltered it can grab a rare,
nonsensical token. So we shape & filter the distribution with 3 knobs 👇
🌡️ Temperature — reshape the distribution before sampling. →0 ≈ greedy (sharp peak); higher = flatter = more creative.
🔢 Top-K — keep only the top K tokens, sample among them. ⚠️ Fixed K isn't adaptive: K=5 is fine when all 5 are
decent, but bad when only 2 are good and #3-5 are 0.x% noise that can derail the model.
🎯 Top-P (nucleus) — keep the smallest set whose cumulative probability ≥ P, then sample. Adaptive: the set grows
when the model is unsure, shrinks when it's confident → usually the better default.
🛑 Stop when ANY fires: an EOS token <|im_end|> is sampled · max_tokens hit · context window full.
⚡ In practice — the golden rules & provider params (as of Mar 2026)
🥇 Change temperature OR top-p, NOT both (tuning both = non-reproducible debugging). Near 0 for code/facts; ~0.7-1+ for creative.

📡 2026 reality check
🎛️ Combos: commercial APIs → Temp + Top-P · OSS (Llama/DeepSeek) → Temp + Min-P · reasoning models → keep defaults.
🆕 Min-P is the newer adaptive filter (keep tokens ≥ P × top-prob) — robust at high temperature. Good starting point: top_p≈0.9, temp≈0.7.
🔁 Greedy's repetition loops? Fight them with frequency / presence / repetition penalties (separate knobs most APIs expose).
🔑 First-principles link to "Attention is All You Need":
That "distribution" is literally the softmax at the top of the transformer. Temperature divides the logits by T before
softmax (÷T). And "the model picks by probability, not correctness" is exactly why hallucination is structural, not a bug.
